notes.title: Ecosystem Architect | Early Access Release Q1 2026
notes.notes:
Ecosystem Architect - launching into Steam Early Access in Q1 2026.



Hey everyone! After about a year and a half of our first release, EcoGenesis, being available on Steam, we are proud to announce a much more ambitous project that you might be interested in - Ecosystem Architect.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848820/eeedfed4c81aac839d010105e8ce0a5288050190.png"]

From the start, this is the game that we envisioned creating. As a two-person indie studio, it just wasn't possible without more exprience and know-how, both from a game development perspective and a business perspective. We were happy with what EcoGenesis accomplished in scope. It was always meant to be a 2D strategy/resource management game with a wildlife theme. We had a lot of fun developing it, and it has been awesome to see that there are people who have enjoyed it as well as used it as a tool for education and learning.

Ecosystem Architect takes aspects of EcoGenesis to a whole new level. In concept, it is very similar. Build your environment the way you want with an expansive list of flora, fauna, and prehistoric creatures. What would happen if a Spinosaurus and Elephant share the same environment? This lets you figure that out first-hand (well, to a degree). Along with the "What if?" of everything, we want this to feel like a true simulation - like every creature in your environment is playing a game of D&D, and you're the GM. Overall, we want to make sure it's a solid mix of deep simulation, strategy, and accessability.



Check out the Steam page here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542870/Ecosystem_Architect/"][/dynamiclink]If it looks like something that's exciting to you, go ahead and wishlist to keep up to date with development updates. The planned Early Access release is currently Q1 of 2026, with a demo coming in the October 2025 Steam Next Fest.



Thanks for playing EcoGenesis! Check out the announcement trailer for Ecosystem Architect here:[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WxYcCUYPmTI"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: "Help" Screen Update - Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Please see below the notes for the newest update to EcoGenesis:
[olist]
 Added a "Help" screen - this goes into extra detail on a lot of aspects in EcoGenesis. Open it up by pressing the '?' button next to the 'Resources' banner.
 Adjusted tutorial text to make it more readable.
 Fixed a couple of visual bugs.
 Fixed a bug related to the ability "Thermo-Regulating Sails" ability (Spinosaurus)
 Fixed some typos.
[/olist]

We're excited to continue to take community feedback into consideration and hear about your experiences with the game.

Thanks for playing!
